newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares seen mixed in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares seen mixed in slow trading.

text.p: Jakarta share prices are seen mixed on Thursday, while the passing of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping was likely to have no significant impact on the market, brokers said.
"We expect the market to be mixed. Local speculators are likely to continue buying actively some secondaries while their foreign counterparts are likely to stay slow," one broker said.
Brokers said foreign players were likely to be low-keyed due to Deng's death.
They, however, said the death was unlikely to have much impact on the market as it had long been discounted.
Secondary engineering firm Bukaka and glue manufacturers Kurnia Kapuas and Intan Wijaya are likely to remain on the active list on speculative interest, they said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 0.33 points, or 0.05 percent, to close at 694.88 points on Wednesday.
